objective: Publish source-supported project rules separately, with explicit applicability and usage timing.

ownership.compression: Preserve original meaning and requirements in evidenced context fields; keep rules=[]; no formal rule extraction or numbering.
ownership.project_rules_agent: Recheck original materials, extract and classify obligations, independently review, then publish project_rules.json.
ownership.downstream: Verify the published reference and receive only the applicable rule records with full text and conditions.

inputs.authority: Roles are explicitly designated in the host input. Ordinary papers do not impose project obligations. Protected files remain inaccessible.

outputs.project_rules.json: Formal rules, version, reviewed source references and scope.
outputs.main.json: Scientific context plus project_rules_ref; reserved rules remains empty.
outputs.rule_audit.json: Source coverage, exact quotations, classification, exclusions and publication mapping.
outputs.report.json: Publication status, findings and next action.
outputs.review/publication_candidate.json: Exact organized final rules and mapping supplied to independent review before publication.

rule_usage.usage.used_in: Applicable downstream stages, derived from reviewed scope.stages.
rule_usage.boundary: Usage annotations do not impose early access to deferred evidence or establish completed compliance checks.
rule_usage.usage.required_phase: Source-stated workflow phase; NOT_SPECIFIED when absent.
rule_usage.usage.deadline: Source-stated deadline; never inferred from observation time.
rule_usage.usage.frequency: Source-stated frequency; never inferred from examples.

execution: LangGraph -> Prefect -> Snakemake: compression -> prepare rule input -> extract -> independent review -> publish.
release: Block publication on failed review, conflicts or invalid evidence; block new-format downstream context without its published rule reference.
compatibility: Historical inputs and approvals retain their versions. Start a new run to adopt this contract.
limitations: Material roles have API/CLI support; a dedicated frontend role editor is not included.
Automated stage filtering does not fully decide biological applicability.
Offline fixture tests establish contract behavior, not real-model extraction accuracy.

processing_rule_revision.focus: Seven extraction-specific rules; full general instructions are inherited separately.
processing_rule_revision.runtime_boundary: New input snapshots use the adopted M01-M03 guide and structured fields; 1.0/1.1 keep their original contracts. No historical input migration or extra model calls.

logical_phases: Bind evidence and full source coverage
method_contract.authority: The references inform processing methods only; they do not create project scientific obligations.
